newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine construction firm CCI to launch IPO.
newsitem.headline: Argentine construction firm CCI to launch IPO.

text.p: An Argentine company formed through the merger of five construction firms has decided to launch an initial public offering, the company said Wednesday.

Concesiones Y Construcciones de Infraestructura SA (CCI) is set to launch its IPO "before the end of the year if markets permit," Alejandro Rossi, head of corporate finance at ING Barings which is advising the company, told Reuters.
An IPO by such a company is likely to be welcomed by investors because of the shortage of listed Argentine firms in the construction business.
CCI, which has annual sales of $200 million, is Argentina's first firm dedicated specifically to the management and construction of infrastructure projects, such as toll roads.
This industry "has an enormous upside," said Rossi. He explained that in Latin America only Mexico has any similar kind of companies.

The company's current strategy is to consolidate its position in the business of infrastructure concessions for transport. In this area it wants to become a key player in the Mercosur customs union of Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay and Paraguay, and elsewhere in Latin America.

CCI will launch an IPO to finance part of its expansion in what it calls "an initiative without precedents to become the first company specialized and focussing on the business of the operation of transport infrastructure."
Rossi said so far the company was only considering issuing an IPO in the local market.
